title: Supreme Court Justices
description: content/supreme-court/justices.yaml: every appointment to the Supreme Court of the United States, one entry per appointment, from the Court's own list and the Federal Judicial Center's Directory. Generated by scripts/law/supreme_court_justices.py; the site reads it (site/src/lib/server/supreme-courts.ts).

service.description: Key of the source record for the Court's list of Justices.

seats.description: Key of the source record for the Federal Judicial Center's Directory.

checked.description: When the script last read the sources.

listed.description: The name as the Court's list prints it, surname first.

appointed_by.description: The President's name as people.yaml gives it.

oath.description: The day the Justice took the judicial oath, which the Court counts as the start of service.

oath_note.description: The Court's list's note on where the oath date comes from, when not its own minutes.

seat.description: The Federal Judicial Center's seat, such as SCT0603 (the third holder of seat 6).

new_seat.description: The statute that created the seat, for a Justice who filled a new one.

follows.description: Who held the seat before, by name.
